profile.headline: Senior System's Engineer at Akimeka

positions.title: San Antonio Office Site-Manager/Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Site manager for the San Antonio Office Project team.  Duties include planning workload, setting deadlines, assigning work, ensuring deliverables meet established QA/QC standards, conducting design reviews,writing yearly performance reviews for developers and providing feedback on testers and requirements analyst reviews.  Primary liaison between San Antonio and remote office. Facilitated communication and project discussions with remote team leads and program manager utilizing teleconferences and video-teleconference technology.  Provided guidance and support on day to day activities to team project members.

positions.title: Information Technology Systems Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Technical Lead providing analytical and technical leadership for 3 to 10 resources, including 3rd party and USAA developers, in implementing various Property & Casualty Insurance software solutions and products in a fast paced environment.  Analyze business need and product requirements to create detailed design documents for use in development.
